title: window.v1
description: FROZEN CONTRACT — do not edit without conductor approval. Monitor input: one window of PRE-AGGREGATED behavioral features. The monitor NEVER sees raw logs, raw request bodies, headers, or any attacker-controlled free text; it sees only the numeric/identity features in this envelope. WINDOWING: 15s tumbling windows (non-overlapping, window_end_ms - window_start_ms == 15000), retained by the monitor in a 6-window ring buffer (90s of history). The monitor scores the current window against the ring and against the `baseline` p95 counterparts carried in this same envelope. One entry in `actors` == one principal within one tenant for exactly this window.

x-contract.producer: feature aggregator (telemetry side of the target app)
x-contract.transport: direct read / local queue into the monitor process (not a Cotal channel)

window_start_ms.description: Inclusive start of the tumbling window, epoch milliseconds UTC.

window_end_ms.description: Exclusive end of the tumbling window, epoch milliseconds UTC. Always window_start_ms + 15000 for a 15s tumbling window.

actors.description: One pre-aggregated feature row per active actor (principal x tenant) in this window. May be empty for an idle window.

actor.title: actor_features
actor.description: Pre-aggregated behavioral features for one principal in one tenant over this 15s window.

principal_hash.description: Stable pseudonymous identifier for the acting principal. Hashed upstream — never a raw username, email, or token.

tenant.description: Tenant identifier the principal acted within.

req.description: Total requests issued by this actor in the window.

distinct_paths.description: Count of distinct normalized request paths touched in the window.

path_entropy.description: Shannon entropy (bits) of the actor's normalized path distribution in the window. High entropy = broad enumeration.

auth_fail.description: Authentication failures (401 / bad credential) in the window.

authz_deny.description: Authorization denials (403 / policy deny) in the window.

deny_ratio.description: (auth_fail + authz_deny) / req for the window. 0 when req == 0.

new_endpoints_first_seen.description: Endpoints this actor touched for the first time ever in this window (novelty signal).

src_ips_distinct.description: Distinct source IPs used by this actor in the window.

ua_distinct.description: Distinct user-agent strings used by this actor in the window. Count only — the UA text itself is never forwarded to the monitor.

session_ids.description: Session identifiers active for this actor in the window. Used downstream as containment/join targets.

cross_tenant_attempts.description: Requests in the window that attempted to reach a tenant other than `tenant` (denied by the app's ordinary controls).

canary_touch.description: True if this actor touched a synthetic canary record or protected export in the window.

post_deny_pivot_ms_p50.description: Median milliseconds between a denial and this actor's next distinct request. Low values indicate machine-speed adaptation rather than a human retrying.

integration_calls.description: Calls made through legitimate integrations or service APIs in the window (lateral-movement surface).

export_bytes.description: Bytes returned to this actor through export / bulk-read endpoints in the window.

baseline.title: baseline_p95
baseline.description: Rolling p95 counterpart for each NUMERIC actor metric, computed over the 6-window ring buffer (90s). `session_ids` (list) and `canary_touch` (boolean) have no p95 counterpart and are deliberately absent. A metric with no history yet is reported as 0.

p95_req.description: p95 of actor.req over the ring buffer.

p95_distinct_paths.description: p95 of actor.distinct_paths over the ring buffer.

p95_path_entropy.description: p95 of actor.path_entropy over the ring buffer.

p95_auth_fail.description: p95 of actor.auth_fail over the ring buffer.

p95_authz_deny.description: p95 of actor.authz_deny over the ring buffer.

p95_deny_ratio.description: p95 of actor.deny_ratio over the ring buffer.

p95_new_endpoints_first_seen.description: p95 of actor.new_endpoints_first_seen over the ring buffer.

p95_src_ips_distinct.description: p95 of actor.src_ips_distinct over the ring buffer.

p95_ua_distinct.description: p95 of actor.ua_distinct over the ring buffer.

p95_cross_tenant_attempts.description: p95 of actor.cross_tenant_attempts over the ring buffer.

p95_post_deny_pivot_ms_p50.description: p95 of actor.post_deny_pivot_ms_p50 over the ring buffer.

p95_integration_calls.description: p95 of actor.integration_calls over the ring buffer.

p95_export_bytes.description: p95 of actor.export_bytes over the ring buffer.
